# Expedia

> > Expedia is a comprehensive travel platform for discovering, planning, and booking activities, attractions, and tours at destinations worldwide.

Expedia offers a centralized marketplace for travelers to explore things to do and local experiences at popular destinations including Hawaii and Universal Orlando Resort. The platform enables users to search, compare, and book activities and attractions through a local search interface integrated with broader travel planning tools.

## Key Topics

- Activities and Attractions
- Things to Do
- Local Search
- Travel Planning
- Tours and Experiences
- Destination Guides
- Activity Booking
- Expedia Platform
- Universal Orlando Resort
- Hawaii Destinations
- Hollywood Attractions

## Activities & Attractions

- [Things To Do Near Me - Find Attractions and Activities](https://www.expedia.com/Activities): Browse and book activities, attractions, and tours worldwide with Expedia. Discover local experiences at popular destinations.
